column4: The company delivered revenue of EUR74 million in 2021, with historical organic revenue growth generally above 10%. [#225](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002520475-225)
We expect organic revenue growth to be very strong between 13% and 15%. [#265](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002520475-265)

Revenue by region now, the performance of France, U.K., Ireland, Southern Europe is mostly a consequence of the level of hospitality in terms of region mix with activity significantly picking up on the back of easy comps. [#103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002520475-103)
Next slide, let's take a look at the '21 monthly organic growth evolution. [#98](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002520475-98)
So now let's talk about our 2022 guidance, starting with organic growth. [#264](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002520475-264)
So it gives you a core organic growth, which shall be above 3%, as mentioned for '21, even accelerating compared to '21. [#482](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002520475-482)

As you can see, there was still around EUR350 million of revenue shortfall in '21, which represents a very strong growth pocket for 2022 as we believe we will close a large part of this EUR350 million gap with a very strong effect expected in H1 this year due to the easier comp. [#263](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002520475-263)
